title: Chargée de mission RSE, qualité & certification Clef Verte (H/F)
description:
L'etablissement Situe au coeur de Saint-Remy-de-Provence, Le Saint-Remy est un hotel 5 etoiles independant de 31 chambres et suites. L'etablissement propose notamment un Spa, deux piscines, le restaurant Lou Patio, l'Achille's Bar ainsi que la Villa Magnolia.
 Dans le cadre de notre demarche environnementale et d'amelioration continue, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Bac+4/5 pour accompagner la Direction sur plusieurs projets structurants pour l'etablissement.
 Votre mission principale : conduire notre candidature Clef Verte Rattache(e) directement a la Presidente de l'etablissement, votre principal objectif sera de preparer et conduire la candidature du Saint-Remy a la certification Clef Verte, depuis l'analyse du referentiel 2027-2031 jusqu'au depot du dossier et au processus de labellisation.
 Des votre arrivee, vous realiserez un diagnostic de l'existant et proposerez a la Direction une roadmap claire, priorisee et datee permettant d'organiser les differentes etapes de la candidature. Identifier les actions necessaires et proposer leur planification. Rediger les documents, procedures, engagements et supports requis. Collecter et organiser les elements de preuve. Suivre la roadmap et preparer le dossier de candidature. Deposer le dossier apres validation de la Direction. Preparer l'audit et assurer le suivi des eventuelles demandes complementaires jusqu'au processus de labellisation. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec le Chef, la Directrice de l'Hebergement et l'Assistante de direction.
 Des le debut du stage : satisfaction client & preparation de la saison 2027 La fermeture hivernale sera mise a profit pour analyser l'ensemble des retours clients de la saison 2026 afin d'identifier les ameliorations pouvant etre engagees avant la reouverture.
 Analyser les enquetes Qualitelis 2026, les verbatims et les principales plateformes d'avis clients. Identifier les points forts, irritants recurrents et principaux axes d'amelioration. Distinguer les problematiques…

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript / Node.js)
description:
Hi, we are Storyteq! Storyteq helps marketing and creative teams in top brands scale their creative production and gain control over their marketing campaigns. Through our platform, our clients streamline campaign workflows, automate their creative production through templates and AI, and activate engaging campaigns that go to market faster. We believe creativity takes time, but creative production shouldn’t. Since 2016 our mission has been to revolutionize the way creative assets are created and used. Magic happens when we let technology empower creativity. Our endless curiosity and relentless commitment to our customers lies at the heart of our problem-solving approach. This shared mission is woven into our values: we dream big, think differently, and are stronger together.
 About the job:
 About the job You will be part of the Templating domain, where we enable global enterprises to scale up their content creation efficiently. Content comes in from sources like Photoshop, Figma and After Effects, or is designed in our AI-enabled, web-based editor, and then taken to the next level. You will work directly with other developers, designers, quality engineers, DevOps engineers and product owners to deliver the best platform for our users. This is a full stack role with TypeScript and Node.js at its core. Most of your time goes into backend services, APIs and data models, and you are just as comfortable picking up a Vue.js frontend task when the feature needs it. You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. title: Engineering Manager
description:
We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise De…

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

PolyAI is hiring a Senior Content Manager to own what we publish and how people find it. You will set the content strategy and write a good share of it yourself. You will also build the systems that let a small team publish at the pace of a much larger one. You will write for three readers: enterprise CX leaders choosing a voice AI partner, developers building agents on our platform and APIs, and the technical audience that follows our models and research.

Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews which voice AI vendors to evaluate, often before they visit a vendor's website. Your job is to get PolyAI into those answers with an accurate description, then turn the visits that follow into sign-ups and sales conversations.

This role suits a writer who builds. You will use Claude Code, AI skills, Git repos and our CMS to turn one strong brief into dozens of strong pages, and you will have the editorial judgment to hold back a page that isn't ready. You won't start from zero: we…

title: Wordpress Web Developer at Private Equity Insights

About us

Private Equity Insights is the world's leading Private Equity community. We connect and develop more than 240,000 investment professionals across the world, through our platforms, which include conferences, webinars, magazines and news reports.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work within a highly talented and motivated team.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your technical, interpersonal, organisation and project management skills through experience and training.
